For Bengaluru–Chennai, online booking is generally instant; “activation time” mainly means ticket confirmation after payment.

Option	Typical fare	Booking/activation
redBus	₹284–₹6,000	Instant e-ticket by email/SMS after payment; broadest choice (350+ buses listed). 
redBus

AbhiBus	From ~₹560 for KSRTC; varies by operator	Instant e-ticket after successful payment; real-time seats and boarding points. 
AbhiBus
+1

IntrCity SmartBus	~₹619–₹729 on listed services	Instant confirmation; AC seater/sleeper options, with some services around 6–9 hours. 
AbhiBus

Practical difference: redBus and AbhiBus are aggregators offering many operators; IntrCity is an operator/service option. For last-minute travel, all three support online confirmation without physical ticket delivery.
